name: kimibox

provenance.pin: kimi-code (release pinned by digest at build time)
provenance.verification: Published checksum verified by the platform's one pinned-fetch contract; never curl-pipe-sh, never npm

headless: Runs non-interactively with the API key injected at runtime from the persistent volume; 'kimi upgrade' self-update is disabled by construction.
self-update-disabled: The managed binary is read-only inside the layer and the self-update subcommand is disabled in managed configuration; a self-installed copy could not persist outside the disposable layer.
policy-interface: The box harness constrains the tool's permission profile to the session's declared scope before launch.
